candidates.name: CPython 3.13 frame-locals proxy and PyFrame_GetLocals
candidates.proposed_use: Give a debugger a write-through view of the selected frame's existing local variables and retain an up-to-date frame namespace view.

citations.section: PyFrame_GetBack L32–38; PyFrame_GetGenerator L59–66; PyFrame_GetLocals L105–113; Frame locals proxies L118–132
PyEval_GetLocals L10–17; PyEval_GetFrame L25–30; PyEval_GetFrameLocals L38–44

candidates.remaining_adapter: Select the desired frame and wire debugger resume behavior; repeated GetBack can traverse callers. The first draft's live locals(), deprecated-API exception behavior and dynamic-name example still require separate integration.
candidates.limitations: The reflected locals() path explicitly snapshots optimized scopes, and the old borrowed-reference API remains available. No delivered test demonstrates threaded generator/coroutine resumption, arbitrary-name execution, or view equality. This is not a claim of whole-draft completion.
